class.name: CameraShake3D
class.brief_description: Shakes the active 3D camera for a short time.
class.description: When [method shake] is called, the active [Camera3D] of the viewport is offset with smooth noise (through [member Camera3D.h_offset] and [member Camera3D.v_offset]) for [member duration] seconds. The intensity decays over time and falls off with the distance between this node and the camera. The original offsets are restored afterwards. As a child of a [ParticleEffect3D], it fires automatically at its start time (see [method ParticleEffect3D.set_emitter_delay]).

method.name: is_shaking
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the camera is being shaken.

method.name: shake
method.description: Starts shaking the active camera. A new shake on the same camera keeps the stronger of the two.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops shaking and restores the camera offsets.

members.member: Length of the shake in seconds.
Speed of the shake noise in Hz.
Distance at which the shake fades out completely. [code]0[/code] shakes at any distance.
Maximum camera offset in meters at the start of the shake.
